title: Team strategy decision (joint with Engram): when to use root coding sessions versus coding delegations, and how many roots
outcome: Team strategy decision (joint with Engram): when to use root coding sessions versus coding delegations, and how many roots
acceptance: A recorded joint decision, concurred by both coordinators (Termal::Fable2 and Engram::Fable), states: roots are for independent claimed packages with their own worktree, evidence and landing; coding delegations are for bounded parallel subwork whose parent integrates; root count matches ready, disjoint packages and host capacity (memory, given the 2026-10-12 exhaustion incident w-66d54f4a4068); and when and how it is reassessed from measured throughput and failures.
The decision names the measurements it will be reassessed against (for example packages landed per hour, gate failures by class, host commit peak, and idle root-hours) and where they are recorded.
